subject.title: [Bug]: Slack thread-session-key ACP binding routing test fails deterministically on main

question: Should maintainers close this protected Slack ACP routing test issue based on the current-main green repro comment, or keep it open for a fresh failing diff?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label blocks automated cleanup closure, and the latest green proof was provided in an issue comment rather than by this read-only review run.

options.title: Close after confirming green
options.body: A maintainer accepts or reruns the focused command on current main and closes this as already fixed if it still passes.

options.title: Keep for fresh failure output
options.body: If anyone still reproduces the mismatch, keep this open and ask for the failing SHA plus the full actual/expected diff.

options.title: Clear protection for repair
options.body: If the test fails and the fix is still narrow, remove the protected label so a focused ClawSweeper repair can be considered later.

recommendation.title: Close after confirming green
recommendation.body: A maintainer accepts or reruns the focused command on current main and closes this as already fixed if it still passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the reporter and the strongest recent Slack prepare/routing history owner in the checked files.
